description: Carried the bag and counted Margaret as eleven's next, which made twelve.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Stood by the box, refused a name, and said there was no show.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Served the goose and required a second shirt.
name: Jacqueline Field

description: Asked nothing about the volume, and told you he had heard you last week.
name: Richard Field

description: Wrote the two shillings by candle and left the rest uncounted.
name: William Shakespeare
